name: plugin.codex_execpolicy
description: Deterministic AST-level shell command execution policy, approval elevation, and sandbox resolution engine ported from OpenAI Codex

entrypoints.name: evaluate_command_policy
entrypoints.description: Evaluates a candidate shell command against active prefix rules and danger patterns to determine allow, prompt, or deny status

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Full shell command string to evaluate

parameters.name: custom_rules
parameters.description: Optional list of custom prefix rules to evaluate against

entrypoints.name: amend_prefix_rule
entrypoints.description: Dynamically add or update an allowed/prompt/deny prefix rule in the active execution policy

parameters.name: prefix_pattern
parameters.description: Command prefix pattern (e.g., 'git status', 'pytest *', 'npm run build')

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: Human-readable description or rationale for this rule

entrypoints.name: tokenize_shell_ast
entrypoints.description: Parses a shell command string into structured AST components (binary, args, operators, redirections) without executing it

entrypoints.name: check_sandbox_requirements
entrypoints.description: Determines platform-native sandboxing requirements (Linux Landlock/Bwrap, macOS Seatbelt, Windows Tokens) for a command

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Command string to analyze for sandbox restrictions

parameters.name: target_platform
parameters.description: Target platform: 'linux', 'macos', or 'windows' (defaults to current OS)
